unassertedReason: A third capture of app://ios/pair-mac, kept for lineage and asserted by nothing. It shows the same camera-preflight state as SURF-014.ios.camera-preflight.png (sha 49be996c) — Camera not started, the Why the camera rationale, Allow camera access, Enter the code instead — so writing a case over it would count one check twice rather than check anything new. It is named UNASSERTED rather than SURF-014 so attach-shots.py cannot stem-match it onto that surface and make it look like a second, independent proof. Note what the two files establish together: they are visually identical and their sha256s differ (6c58ee19 vs 49be996c), so byte-identity across runs is not an oracle on the iOS lane the way it is on the Mac one.
